parts.prompt: The FIRST image is a pose template: flat grey shapes and a gun on magenta. The SECOND image is the character (use ONLY the template's pose, not the second image's). Paint the bearded man in the dark brown waxed field jacket and scarf from the second image as ONE single drawing exactly over the template, keeping the template's exact position, size, angles, framing and aspect ratio: the grey torso and head become the character's own torso and head (same clothes, same face and hair), the light grey arm is the character's RIGHT arm (near the camera) and the dark grey arm is his LEFT arm (far side), and the gun is the same black AR-15 carbine at exactly the same place, angle and size as in the template. A relaxed LOW READY pose, NOT aiming: the butt of the stock still tucked in the pocket of the right shoulder, the gun angled muzzle-down about forty degrees toward the ground in front, the right hand on the pistol grip with the index finger straight along the side of the receiver OFF the trigger, the left hand holding the fore-end from below; head UP, chin level, eyes looking straight ahead over the gun (not down the sights); torso upright, shoulders relaxed. Upper body only: the figure ends at the hips at the bottom of the grey torso shape, NO legs. Strict side view, the camera on the character's right, facing right.
